preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The length of the string S must be between 1 and 10000.
The string S must contain exactly one white cell.

postconditions.description: If the number of black cells on either side of the white cell is even, Chef wins; otherwise, Aleksa wins.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= T <= 10","description":"The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= len(S) <= 10000","description":"The length of the string S must be between 1 and 10000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"S.count('W') == 1","description":"The string S must contain exactly one white cell."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == 'Chef' if (len(S) - S.index('W')) % 2 == 0 else stdout == 'Aleksa'","description":"If the number of black cells on either side of the white cell is even, Chef wins; otherwise, Aleksa wins."}],"invariants":[]}
